lyrics:
[verse]
That toy costs an arm and a leg?
Bruno held out his paw, I beg!
Kiki laughed, keep your paws, it's fine,
It just means a really high price sign!
[chorus]
An arm and a leg, an arm and a leg,
Costs so much, it makes you beg!
An arm and a leg, an arm and a leg,
Way too pricey, says the tag!
[verse]
It means a price that's way too high,
So much money, oh my, oh my,
Save your coins and wait a while,
Then you'll buy it with a smile!
[chorus]
An arm and a leg, an arm and a leg,
Costs so much, it makes you beg!
An arm and a leg, an arm and a leg,
Fill your piggy bank, peg by peg!
[outro]
So when a price makes you go whoa,
It costs an arm and a leg, you know!
